For 3<β<4 and 4<β<9/2 the one-step event reduces exactly to (0,β/2), whose integral through the source densities gives (β+4)/18 and (β+20)/54 respectively; direct boundary density integration establishes β=3,4. At β=4 the four-cell Markov partition has invariant weights (1,2,4,2)/9 and the displayed exact transition matrix. For centered branch sensor v, P^2v=-v/2 and the lag-one centered dot product is zero, yielding the all-lag formula for every n by an exact matrix identity, not by finite extrapolation. Binary covariance zero is equivalent to pair independence at the same marginal, and the negative-run obstruction proves not iid. Standalone rational CHECKER.py rechecks PF stationarity over all parameter subchambers by affine interpolation, normalization, first-lag integral, matrix identities and independent branch-cylinder enumeration up to lag12. Infinite statements rest on explicit algebra, not computational pattern-fitting.

value.rationale: The observable is the dynamically natural positive-branch indicator that directly computes the Lyapunov exponent. Its one-lag correlation distinguishes parameter regimes invisible to the known constant Lyapunov mean, with a unique sign transition at the canonical 4-cell Markov point. At that point the complete infinite odd/even lag spectrum exhibits pairwise independence at every odd separation but nontrivial and alternating even-lag dependence, a striking exact obstruction to conclusions from one-lag independence. The theorem is structurally motivated, covers a natural full parameter range for its one-lag component and all infinitely many lags at its special parameter, and is not merely a recomputation of the known invariant-density table.
